titre: Lallai Manzon Allah SAW yayi tofi a Qafar Amr Bn Mu'az lokacin da Qafarsa ta cire kuma ya warke
hadith: Daga Buraida -Allah ya yarda da shi- ya ce: "Lallai Manzon Allah SAW yayi tofi a Qafar Amr Bn Mu'az lokacin da Qafarsa ta cire kuma ya warke"
attribution: Ibnu Hibban ne ya Rawaito shi
explication: Yayin da Qafar Amr Bn Mu'az -Allah ya yarda da shi- ta cire saarke i Annabi SAW yayi tofi a cikinta daga yawunsa mai tsarki, sai ya warke kuma ya samu sauqi da yardar Allah, kuma wannan yana daga cikin Mu'ajiza bayyananniya ta Manzon Allah SAW
ar: عن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: «إنَّ رسولَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تَفَلَ في رِجْل عمرو بن مُعاذ حِين قُطِعتْ رِجْلُه، فبَرأَ».
